catalyst_rows.indication: Prevention of surgical site infections (SSIs) in colorectal surgery
catalyst_rows.raw_text: March 30, 2026: PolyPid initiated NDA submission to FDA for D-PLEX100 for prevention of SSIs in colorectal surgery under Fast Track rolling review. First modules (CMC, nonclinical) submitted; clinical section to follow imminently. FDA also granted small business waiver of ~$4.3M PDUFA fee.

catalyst_rows.indication: Prevention of SSIs in colorectal surgery
catalyst_rows.raw_text: PDUFA target action date to be confirmed following NDA acceptance and planned for first quarter of 2027 for D-PLEX100. Breakthrough Therapy Designation previously granted.

catalyst_rows.indication: Prevention of SSIs in colorectal surgery (EU)
catalyst_rows.raw_text: MAA for D-PLEX100 to be submitted to EMA under Centralized Procedure on basis of therapeutic innovation in Q3 2026. Meetings with Rapporteur and Co-Rapporteur scheduled for Q2 2026.

catalyst_rows.indication: Prevention of SSIs in colorectal surgery
catalyst_rows.raw_text: At 45th Surgical Infection Society (SIS) Annual Meeting May 2026: ASEPSIS score analysis showed 64% relative risk reduction (p=0.0103) in proportion of patients with ASEPSIS >20 in D-PLEX100 arm. ESCMID Global 2026 April PK data showed sustained doxycycline release ~30 days with minimal systemic exposure.
